depthProbe.note: Screen edges with no geometry → depth≈far → full ray length in fog march

settle.note: After settle both bloom+fog should be flat — high corr only if still ramping

diagnosis.b_exactTerm: VolumetricFogPass composite/in-scatter at screen-edge far-depth rays

diagnosis.proofRequirement: A fix is ONLY proven when settle300 edge residMaxDev / edgePulseScore goes flat (±~0) under THIS same instrument. test:smoke is NOT proof.
